_about: STAR-style state objects for the state-structure test (probes/star_state_test.py). Written 2026-10-16 BEFORE any result was seen; do not edit after scoring. One situation and one task per published set: what kind of text it is and who reads it for what. They describe the setting only, never the answer. 'filler' is the length-and-shape control: the same keys with no information.

emotion_anger.situation: A comment posted by one user in an online discussion thread on Reddit, replying to other users.
emotion_anger.task: A community moderator is reading comments to understand how each writer feels about what they are replying to.

politeness_deference.situation: A short request written by one contributor to another on a collaborative website (a wiki talk page or a question-and-answer site).
politeness_deference.task: Someone is reviewing how contributors phrase their requests to each other.

phishing.situation: A message that someone received: an email, a text message or a piece of web text.
phishing.task: A security reviewer is checking incoming messages before anyone acts on them.

manipulation_dialogue.situation: A transcribed conversation between two people, taken from a film or television script.
manipulation_dialogue.task: A counselor is reviewing the conversation to understand how the two speakers try to influence each other.

persuasion_appeals.situation: An online chat between two crowd workers. One of them, the persuader, is trying to get the other to donate part of their task payment to the charity Save the Children. This is one sentence the persuader wrote.
persuasion_appeals.task: A researcher is labelling which persuasion strategy each persuader sentence uses.

checklist_contractnli.situation: An excerpt from a non-disclosure agreement (NDA) between two parties.
checklist_contractnli.task: A lawyer is checking which obligations and definitions this contract text does and does not contain.

filler.situation: This is a piece of text that has been provided here for review purposes in this request.
filler.task: Someone is looking at this piece of text and would like an answer to the question below.
